evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models.
